name: Kayabuki Rika
source:
Akira's mother, who is strict with both herself and others. She is very strict about Akira's future and career, and has completely degraded her relationship with him. Due to how she speaks calmly and without hesitation, she is often misunderstood as being angry all the time.

The reason why she is so strict with her son has to do with her past experiences.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1138957]Getchu[/url]]
